scenario: LUNI.3.2 and LLEX.12 with LLEX.11.1's digit grouping: in `1_000_meter_squared`, the `_` between digits is a group separator, the `_` before the first letter is the unit separator, and the `_` inside the suffix is part of the unit's name. The literal is 1000 of `meter_squared`, one token. It is compared with an `area` slot, so the rule compiles only if the whole suffix resolves; stopping at `meter` would leave `_squared` naming nothing. The library is the shipped `stdlib/units/si.ds`, on every fixture's search path ([RCTS.1.2.14]).
rules_ds:
from units.si import meter_squared

schema Plot scope logical:
    id: String key
    area: meter_squared mutable

rule large:
    Plot p where p.area > 1_000_meter_squared
->
    log info "x"
